description:
LAST DAY to join the Awesome Socks Club or the Awesome Undies Club (or both, so you match): https://good.store/collections/awesome-socks-and-undies-main

Awesome Socks Club: https://good.store/products/awesome-socks-club-subscription-1
Awesome Undies Club: https://good.store/products/awesome-undies-club-subscription
Give it as a gift (including the 12-month pre-purchase): https://good.store/collections/giftable-subscriptions

The Awesome Socks Club has cost $13.75 a month since 2022. If it had tracked with inflation, it would be over $16 now. Our costs have gone up like everyone else's, but the amount we send to Partners in Health hasn't gone down substantially, and this video is about how a lot of people worked very hard to pull that off.

Now, of course, as a growing small business we had a lot more opportunity for efficiency than a big mature business so I'm not saying that, like, the banana people could have done the same...but we were lucky to have some options.

title: How to Not Raise Prices
